 This Writ Petition Is Filed Under Articles 226
And 227 Of The Constitution Of India Praying To
Direct The Respondents To Consider And To Dispose
Of The Application Dated 09.11.2020 Filed By The
Petitioners Under Section 28(A)(1) Of

Land
Acquisition Act 1894, Vide Annexures -A B C D E F G H
J K L M N P Q R As Expeditiously As Possible In
Accordance With Law

. 
 This Petition, Coming On For Preliminary
Hearing, This Day, The Court Made The Following:
 Order

Learned Additional Government Advocate is directed to take notice for respondents 1 and 2.
NC: 2023:KHC:33743

Present petition is seeking direction to respondents to consider the application dated 09.11.2020 filed by the petitioners under Section 28(A)(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 and case of the petitioners is that they are the owners of land described in their application produced at Annexures-A to R and that their lands were acquired by respondents in terms of notification dated 24.07.1986.
That the award was passed and due to ignorance they could not seek for reference of the matter under Section 18 of the Act, 1894.

That recently they learnt about enhancement of award made in LAC No.64/2014 in respect of lands similarly situated to that of the petitioners and that the petitioners are also entitled for similar quantum of compensation.
Therefore petitioners filed application under Section 28(A)(1) as per Annexures A to R on 09.11.2020.
That the respondent authorities have not considered the said applications even after lapse of almost three years constraining the petitioners to approach this Court.
Learned Additional Government Advocate for respondents 1 and 2 in response submits that if given some time the applications filed by the petitioners will be considered in accordance with law.

In that view of the matter, petition is disposed of directing the respondent authorities to consider the applications filed by the petitioners as above within an outer limit of twelve weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.

SD/-
